featured_reviews.name: Timmy
featured_reviews.review_text:
I experienced a highly unsafe and unacceptable cab ride on 14th March at 5:15 AM, from Sheraton Hyderabad Hotel to Rajiv Gandhi International Airport.

I had scheduled this cab the previous night specifically to ensure a timely and safe airport transfer. Unfortunately, what I experienced was extremely unprofessional, unsafe, and alarming.

1. Delay in pickup
Despite scheduling the ride for 5:15 AM, the cab did not arrive on time. When I called the driver, he claimed he was already at the hotel entrance. However, he only arrived around 10 minutes later, which was misleading and unprofessional.

2. OTP verification ignored
During booking confirmation, I received an OTP that is normally required to start the trip. When I asked the driver if he needed the OTP, he casually said it was “not required.” This raises serious concerns about whether standard safety protocols are being followed by your drivers.

3. Extremely drowsy and unsafe driver
The most disturbing issue was that the driver was clearly extremely drowsy and struggling to stay awake while driving. His eyes were visibly drooping and he appeared incapable of maintaining proper focus on the road.

At one point, he almost lost control of the vehicle and drove into a pothole. I had to repeatedly call out to him and keep talking to him just to make sure he stayed awake. He tried turning on loud music, switching on the lights inside the car, and eating snacks, yet he continued to struggle with sleep.

Additionally, whenever he responded to me, he would turn away from the road and look back at me in the rear seat for around 5-6 seconds while speaking. This was extremely alarming as he was taking his eyes off the road for a prolonged time while the vehicle was in motion.

As a passenger, it was extremely disturbing that I had to stay alert and ensure the driver remained awake to avoid a possible accident.

4. Unnecessary stop during the trip
The driver also stopped midway to have chai, which was completely unacceptable during an airport transfer, especially when the passenger is already dealing with an unsafe situation.

5. Reckless and poor lane discipline
Throughout the journey, the driver failed to maintain lane discipline, frequently drifting between lanes and driving across divider lines for extended periods. Multiple vehicles had to continuously honk at us because he was blocking lanes and changing lanes without indication. It genuinely felt like the vehicle was not fully under his control.

This journey normally takes about 30 minutes, but those 30 minutes were one of the most frightening and stressful travel experiences I have ever had. At one point, I seriously considered getting down and arranging another vehicle. However, given that it was early morning on a highway, I had no safe alternative.

It is extremely concerning that a driver who is clearly unfit to drive due to exhaustion was allowed to take a passenger for an airport ride. This is a major safety failure.

Thankfully, I reached the airport safely without any accident. I can only say that I am grateful nothing worse happened during this ride.

I strongly urge your team to investigate this incident seriously and take strict action, as allowing drivers in such condition to operate vehicles puts passengers’ lives at risk.

This experience was completely unacceptable and deeply concerning. I expect this matter to be treated with the seriousness it deserves.
